sources.title: We Tested The New Qwen3.5 Open Weight, Qwen3.5-Plus
sources.snippet: Now, building on that evolution, comes the Qwen 3.5 family with two new AI models - its first open weight model: the Qwen3.5 397B-A17B, and the Qwen3.5-Plus. Among the two, the former, or the Qwen3.5 397B-A17B, is the flagship model, while the Qwen3.5-Plus is the hosted model available via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.
